description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Target: improve discrimination from current 4 distinct values. Must read MULTIPLE fields from metadata dict (permission_scope, requested_permissions, optional_permissions, dangerous_permission_count, permission_granularity, permission_denial_rate). Compute a score in [0.0, 100.0] with evidence dict listing partial scores. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Will be exercised by enrichment_harness.py. This directly addresses the weak signal with 4 distinct values per Signal Quality Diagnostic.
